method: Nested five-fold whole-trial evaluation; inner three-fold selection. Two real one-second captures per trial. Scaling, kernels, classifier weights and support radii use training trials only; all rejections count as failures.

label_interpretation.distance_below_0.0cm.csv: BELOW_ZERO; recorded numeric 0 is a placeholder, not an exact target
label_interpretation.distance_higher_8.0cm.csv: ABOVE_EIGHT; recorded numeric 9 is treated as a range label, not proof of exact 9 cm

limitation: Dataset 2 contains all in-range trials and dataset 3 contains only the tails: session and region are confounded. No fresh-session in-range boundary controls or independent test set. No exact negative or above-range distances are inferred.
